# True Attendly - Luxury Retail Growth Automation Platform

An app-less digital customer engagement ecosystem for brick-and-mortar retail stores operating via dynamic in-store QR codes.

## Core Features

*   **Live In-Store Flash Offers:**
    Merchants can create, edit, activate, and deactivate real-time flash offers directly from their mobile-optimized dashboard, establishing a live discount catalog that is rendered instantly on customer phone browsers upon scanning in-store QR codes. The interface includes a dual-mode, bidirectional price builder that converts pricing changes into discount percentages automatically (or vice-versa) to simplify the user experience. All product images uploaded by merchants are securely stored in the Supabase Storage `'flash-offers'` bucket, mapped under their unique shop identifiers. Operationally, publishing or updating an active flash offer debits exactly 2 credits from the merchant's wallet using the atomic `deduct_credits` database RPC to ensure balance consistency. A soft-delete flag (`is_deleted`) hides removed offers from public view while preserving historical view metrics for business analytics.

*   **Frictionless Digital Billing (POS Counter):**
    The organic checkout terminal facilitates paperless billing at physical retail counters, capturing customer leads instantly. Merchants compile active customer baskets using a camera-based barcode scanning engine built on the browser's native `BarcodeDetector` API, complete with custom frame rate capping to save device CPU and a manual input fallback for non-camera environments. At checkout, the system uses the atomic PostgreSQL RPC function `create_digital_invoice_with_items` to insert parent invoice details and child line items simultaneously, preventing partial data writes. The counter then renders a dynamic QR code wrapping a WhatsApp deep link containing a sequential, date-and-random-jitter-prefixed invoice identifier (INV-YYYYMMDD-[5-digit jitter]) to prevent collisions. Customers scan the QR code to verify their purchase details, get lead-captured, and receive their bills on WhatsApp. Using Supabase real-time subscriptions, the dashboard monitors transaction updates and automatically clears the active counter cart when a delivery webhook confirms successful receipt. All former dummy simulation UI utilities have been deprecated.

*   **Audience Master Registry:**
    The platform's audience manager provides a secure, single-tenant master database table (`customers_master`) optimized for high-retention retail marketing. To prevent data ingestion errors, bulk contact uploads from `.csv` and `.xlsx` files are parsed using client-side helper libraries and batched in chunks of 500 rows or fewer, avoiding Supabase gateway timeouts. The ingestion process strips invalid characters using strict non-digit regex masking, validating and formatting numbers to 10 digits before executing a duplicate-safe database upsert mapped on a composite `(shop_id, whatsapp_number)` constraint. The audience directory is separated into a clean upload/insertion node and a high-performance terminal (`/dashboard/customers/management`). The terminal utilizes an infinite scroll structure powered by the `IntersectionObserver` API to load 50 records at a time, protecting browser memory. For shop owners on the floor, the interface displays contacts in responsive card views with simple mobile touch targets, featuring instant name search, alphabetical sorting, and filters for customer segments like VIP, Regular, and New.

*   **Monetization & Credit Constraints:**
    True Attendly features a transparent, transactional credit ledger that eliminates fixed monthly subscription overheads. Every merchant storefront is associated with a row in the `wallets` table that tracks credit balances. Creating or editing an active Flash Offer costs exactly 2 credits, while requesting any AI features (Copy Polish, Flash Offer copy optimization, Spintax generator) costs exactly 1 credit per request. Sending a WhatsApp broadcast campaign costs exactly 1 credit per recipient. To prevent race conditions or balance tampering, credits are never calculated in client-side memory; instead, all balance actions are processed at the database layer using Postgres RPC functions (`deduct_credits`) running under database-level row locks. Inbound credits are bought via Cashfree integration, where checkouts require immediate interface locks to avoid duplicate clicks. Webhooks are ingested by a serverless callback listener, which authenticates the gateway message, bypasses RLS using Supabase Service Role keys, and relies on Postgres Unique Violation exceptions (Code `23505`) to prevent duplicate balance infusions. Successful payments invoke an atomic mathematical increment RPC (`public.increment`) on the wallet.

*   **Exclusion Matrix & Clean Focus:**
    All legacy email marketing, SMTP server configurations, and email campaigns are systematically and permanently purged from the application. The sidebar navigation menu (`/dashboard/layout.tsx`) and landing page feature grid have been completely scrubbed of email-related links, stubs, and components to enforce a highly focused, app-less WhatsApp and QR-only digital retail engagement platform.
